deviation: The draft replaces Arcadia's performance warranty (reasonable skill and care, SOW conformity, 90-day free correction) with a blanket "as is" disclaimer. It also states the Supplier does not warrant that defects will be corrected, and it disclaims title and non-infringement. Arcadia would have no warranty or remedy for defective services, which breaches the playbook's "no blanket disclaimers" position and is worse than the 60-day fallback.
suggested_text:
10.1 The Supplier warrants that the Services and Deliverables will be performed with reasonable skill and care and will conform to the applicable Statement of Work. The Supplier shall correct or re-perform any non-conforming Services or Deliverables free of charge for 90 days after acceptance.
10.2 The Supplier further warrants that it has the right to provide the Services, Deliverables and Supplier IP, and that their use as contemplated by this Agreement will not infringe any third party's intellectual property rights.
10.3 Nothing in this Agreement excludes or limits any warranty, condition or liability that cannot be excluded or limited by law.
